title: RMSNorm
signature: def rmsnorm(x: np.ndarray, weight: np.ndarray, eps: float = 1e-6) -> np.ndarray
hints: RMSNorm is LayerNorm without the mean: there is no centering and no bias.
The root mean square is taken over the last axis only, one value per row.
eps goes inside the square root: sqrt(mean(x^2) + eps). Use keepdims=True so it broadcasts back.
